title: nan
authors: Xiao X.; Fan Y.; Dufek J.; Murphy R.
key_contribution: Presents a tether-based indoor UAV localization method using catenary mechanics modeling from tether sensory feedback for GPS-denied environments, validated on a physical tethered robot.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
